<h2>Build R Architecture Dependency Map</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Builds deterministic Markdown describing repository R ownership,
pipeline/profile/store relationships, persisted contracts, and exceptions.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>build_r_architecture_dependency_map(
  data_scripts,
  data_functions,
  data_contracts,
  data_manifests,
  data_exceptions
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_scripts">data_scripts</code></td>
<td>
<p>Script-path inventory data frame.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_functions">data_functions</code></td>
<td>
<p>Function inventory data frame.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_contracts">data_contracts</code></td>
<td>
<p>Persisted-contract inventory data frame.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_manifests">data_manifests</code></td>
<td>
<p>Manifest-derived profile and target inventory data frame.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_exceptions">data_exceptions</code></td>
<td>
<p>Maintained architecture-exception ledger.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Character vector containing the architecture map Markdown.
</p>


<h3>Examples</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>build_r_architecture_dependency_map(
  data_scripts = tibble::tibble(
    classification = "main_analysis",
    migration_status = "migrated"
  ),
  data_functions = tibble::tibble(
    current_path = "R/Functions/example.R",
    intended_path = "R/Functions/example.R",
    migration_status = "baseline_recorded",
    callers = "R/Pipelines/_pipes/pipe_segment_example.R"
  ),
  data_contracts = tibble::tibble(
    contract_type = "literal_target",
    contract_scope = "persisted_internal"
  ),
  data_manifests = tibble::tibble(
    profile_id = "example",
    profile_role = "smoke",
    pipeline_id = "example",
    pipeline_script = "R/Pipelines/example.R",
    target_store = "Data/targets/example",
    manifest_target_count = 1L
  ),
  data_exceptions = tibble::tibble(
    exception_id = character(),
    owner_issue = character(),
    expiry_issue = character()
  )
)
</code></pre>
